groups.saying_opens: الحمس هم الذين أنزل الله عز وجل

notes: Two sayings with two isnads (rule 4a): the description of the tawaf, and Aisha's account of the Hums verse, both carried by Hisham (قال هشام فحدثني أبي عن عائشة).
The second group's head runs through the speaker Hisham (occurrence 2), as in the rule 3 example with قال وحدثني.
أبيه and أبي are read as relations, since the father is not named.
